description: This plot illustrates "Performance w.r.t. Temperature" by comparing the accuracy of three different methods across varying temperature values. The x-axis is labeled "Temperature" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)" and features a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 62.5 to 80.0 at intervals of 2.5. The "On-policy RL" method is represented by a solid gold line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it begins at an accuracy of approximately 63.7 at a temperature of 0.1, rises to 69.9 at 0.2, and eventually reaches a plateau of 71.7 at temperatures 0.5 and 0.6 before dropping to 67.3 at 0.7, peaking at 75.2 at 0.8, and ending at 73.5 at 1.0. The "LUFFY" method is depicted by a solid maroon line with star markers, starting at 76.1 at 0.1, rising to 78.8 at 0.2, and remaining steady at 76.1 for 0.3 and 0.4; it later climbs to reach its highest values of 80.5 at both 0.8 and 1.0, with a slight dip to 78.8 at 0.9. Finally, the "SFT" method is shown as a solid dark teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers, beginning at 76.1 at 0.1 and gradually declining to 74.3 at 0.3 and 0.4 before dropping sharply to its lowest point of 69.9 at 0.5; it then spikes to a peak of 76.1 at 0.6, fluctuates down to 71.7 at 0.7 and 0.9, and concludes at 74.3 at a temperature of 1.0.
